hunted_j16: On Day 3 Henrik Hunted took a post at R-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Officers came to inspect R-F4. Henrik Hunted polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Henrik Hunted had Jakub "Hollow" Hill of the Hegemony in the sights at the Hanging Bridge for a long second. Jakub "Hollow" Hill was lighting a pipe. Henrik Hunted let the match burn all the way down. Hill 304 is lost. Henrik Hunted heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Henrik Hunted tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Henrik Hunted and Ivo Joha divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
A rat stole Henrik Hunted's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Henrik Hunted across the shin at R-F4. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11).
miguell.jacob: The new runner is Otto "Ash" Jacob, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Otto "Ash" Jacob said he would find out.
Volunteer number 41. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Otto "Ash" Jacob's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Otto "Ash" Jacob began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F14 with the rations. Otto "Ash" Jacob ate while listening to the revised orders.
The reply to Otto "Ash" Jacob's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Otto "Ash" Jacob and Wendel "Mole" Freddie made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Otto "Ash" Jacob in the thigh at R-F14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Otto "Ash" Jacob folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Outside the aid post, Otto "Ash" Jacob lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon. Otto "Ash" Jacob's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. Otto "Ash" Jacob finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Otto "Ash" Jacob opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F14 they cheered when the news came up the line.
The medics called Otto "Ash" Jacob 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Otto "Ash" Jacob is back on the line.

A bullet hit Otto "Ash" Jacob in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F14. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230). Otto "Ash" Jacob was killed outright at R-F14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).
A letter came with Rafael Jacob: "I am Otto "Ash" Jacob's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
someonenamedmiguel: Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed walked into R-F19 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Otto Elitecelebs (Hegemony) at Calvary Farm. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.

Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed fixed the strap on Gideon "Ghost" Marks's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed's helmet at R-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed at R-F19, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.
Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed had heard about Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed's courage. At R-F19, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F19. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Cyril Zgeorges of the Hegemony (@zgeorges11). A letter from home found Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed before the night shift. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F19. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip).
tom_ua_: In Belmonte, Anselm Tom was a railway porter. In S-F9, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Volunteer number 94. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Anselm Tom's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The transfer made Anselm Tom a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Anselm Tom thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the cold felt a little further away.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Verdel Ridge is lost. Anselm Tom heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F9. Anselm Tom took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
The wound Anselm Tom shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.

Anselm Tom drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Anselm Tom did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Anselm Tom did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

Ulrich Tom took the same post at S-F9 where Anselm Tom stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Tom was number 94. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.

A sniper's bullet hit Ulrich Tom at S-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Ulrich Tom was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The worst has passed for Ulrich Tom. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Ulrich Tom healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Ulrich Tom checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
zgeorges11: Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Verdel Ridge is lost. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Gideon "Whistle" Vylet, grazed.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) and Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Chalk Pits. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.

A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges at R-F18 and the bearers came at a run. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges died waiting. The men at R-F18 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers say Cyril Zgeorges. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges's eyes. Nobody in R-F18 argues.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Cyril Zgeorges fired, and Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was grazed.
Cyril Zgeorges and Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
